_comment: Typos in sources, confirmed by a human. Before parsing, 'text' is replaced by 'read_as' in the fetched page. A correction stops applying by itself when the source no longer shows 'text'; unused corrections are reported in the source's parser-problem issue so they can be removed. See pipeline/problems.py.

corrections.note: Visättrahallen, ordinary Monday time. Every other time on the page writes hour.minute; '11-00' is 11.00.
